newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pechiney confirms eying TPI control.
newsitem.headline: Pechiney confirms eying TPI control.

text.p: Pechiney confirmed on Monday that it was eyeing control of its 39-percent deluxe cosmetics packaging unit Techpack International (TPI).
"Chairman Jean-Pierre Rodier has said that in coming weeks we might buy the stake held by LBO France," a company spokesman said.
Rodier made the comments during a visit to Brazil last week. The spokesman also said the transaction might take place before the end of May.
LBO France owns 40 percent of TPI and TPI management the balance.
TPI produces deluxe, high value-added plastic packaging for perfumes and cosmetics and generated sales of 1.6 billion francs for the fiscal year ended June 30, 1995.
